notes: C5 (overdoping on KTO dome) and C25 (ordinary photo-induced carrier/mobility changes without PNR randomization) both map to P15/P19, where the review argues that T_c simply tracks the known KTO(111) gating/mobility curve without a separate PNR channel; C5 is marked partly because P15 frames this around the known KTO(111) T_c-mobility/confinement curve rather than overdoping on the dome. C2 (Arrhenius decay of the memory state) is marked partly via P20 (which tests Arrhenius matching on the post-illumination relaxation in Fig. 4) and P26 (thermally stimulated depolarization after gating).
